# Wisc Launcher

> Free, open-source Minecraft Java Edition launcher built with Python and Flet.

Source: https://github.com/wisc-launcher/wisc

## Website

- [Small launcher. Clear purpose.](__SITE_URL__/about): Wisc is a free, open-source Minecraft Java Edition launcher built with Python and Flet.
- [Make room for smoother play.](__SITE_URL__/benchmarks): Choose the right Java runtime, keep your profiles organized, and tune settings for your own Minecraft setup.
- [No extra tracking.](__SITE_URL__/cookies): This website has no added analytics, advertising scripts, application cookies, or local-storage features.
- [Your skin. Your style.](__SITE_URL__/cosmetics): Import a skin PNG, preview its model, and manage your Ely.by appearance inside the launcher.
- [A little guidance. A lot of play.](__SITE_URL__/docs): Everything you need to install Wisc, manage profiles, and understand your launcher data.
- [Before you hit Play.](__SITE_URL__/doctor): A simple launch checklist for Wisc. Check these settings in the launcher and your game folder.
- [Ready when you are.](__SITE_URL__/download): Get Wisc Launcher for Windows x64, or run the Python source on your own system.
- [Every path, in one place.](__SITE_URL__/files): Browse the website’s product pages, guides, tools, and policy documents.
- [Your first world awaits.](__SITE_URL__/getting-started): Install the launcher, choose a profile, and make sure Java matches your Minecraft version.
- [A hand when you need one.](__SITE_URL__/help): Find a practical guide or report a reproducible launcher issue.
- [Minecraft, without the noise.](__SITE_URL__/): Versions, mods and skins in one dark, quiet window. A free, open-source Minecraft Java Edition launcher.
- [Open source, with credit.](__SITE_URL__/licenses): The launcher’s source and bundled third-party components retain their own license terms.
- [One window. Your Minecraft.](__SITE_URL__/minecraft-launcher): Wisc brings Minecraft Java versions, profiles, mods, skins, and launch settings together.
- [A whole new setup.](__SITE_URL__/modpacks): Browse Modrinth and CurseForge packs, or import a pack archive into a separate instance.
- [Your mods, in order.](__SITE_URL__/mods): Discover compatible mods, install local JARs, and manage each profile’s collection.
- [Meet in the same world.](__SITE_URL__/multiplayer): Connect from Minecraft’s Multiplayer screen using a compatible profile and the server’s account requirements.
- [Your data, explained.](__SITE_URL__/privacy): Understand the website’s external requests and the launcher’s local data and connected services.
- [Free to download.](__SITE_URL__/refunds): Wisc Launcher has no paid downloads, subscriptions, or purchases on this website.
- [A few clear terms.](__SITE_URL__/terms): Use Wisc with respect for Minecraft’s license, provider rules, and the project’s open-source license.
- [Get back to your world.](__SITE_URL__/troubleshooting): Work through the common causes of launch, download, mod, and skin problems.

## Current project details

- Current release packages are Windows x64; their published filenames retain Gr8Launcher.
- Source requires Python 3.10+ and game launch requires compatible Java.
- Current account options are offline usernames and Ely.by.
- Ely.by sign-in unlocks skin customization in the launcher.
- Modpack installations create separate instances and retain pack-managed version pins.
- Wisc is independent of Mojang and Microsoft.
